title: Deals: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max launch, Galaxy S26 and Pixel 11 series drop prices
description: Pre-orders for the new iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max started this Saturday. Premium Apple models rarely get discounts and never this early, so we’ll just list their prices here for the sake of comparison with flagship Androids that might lure you away from the siren call of a new iPhone. So, here are the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. They feature Apple’s first 2nm chip, the A20 Pro, which runs at close to 5GHz (it peaks at 4.93GHz) and posted massive Geekbench scores. Additionally, the new models promise longer battery life, especially the Pro Max. And they have a variable aperture for the...

title: vivo shows all colors of the X500 Pro Max
description: vivo is unveiling the X500 series in China on September 21, and ahead of that, a few days ago the company revealed the design of the X500 Pro Max. Today it's back with more official images, this time showing all four colors in which the phone will be available. Here they are for your viewing pleasure. vivo X500 Pro Max in all colors The X500 Pro Max is expected to be powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro SoC. It will have a main camera with a custom sensor co-developed with Sony which will offer 17EV of dynamic range. Its 200MP periscope telephoto camera will be the same...

title: OnePlus 16 may not launch in India
description: According to a new rumor from a tipster on X, OnePlus may not be launching the upcoming OnePlus 16 in India. Instead, the OnePlus 16R will be the brand's next flagship in the country. It will be followed by new Nord series and N series devices. In recent years, OnePlus has launched a new flagship number-series device as well as an R-series model, which uses a lesser chipset and comes with lesser cameras and a big battery. Now, if this rumor pans out, it means India will miss out on a OnePlus device powered by the upcoming Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chipset, and will have to make do with the...

title: Fairphone's Fairbuds 2 earbuds leak in two colors
description: Fairphone launched its first pair of true wireless earbuds, aptly called the Fairbuds, in April of 2024. Now the company is almost ready to introduce the second generation - in fact, the Fairbuds 2 are coming in the fourth quarter of this year (between October and December). Today a new leak brings us a look at the new earbuds in green and black. Fairbuds 2 leaked images As you can see, the Fairbuds 2 have stems, while the originals didn't. Their case is also thicker than the original one, which makes us wonder whether Fairphone has managed to fit a larger battery inside than...

title: Samsung Galaxy A08 retailer listing gives us specs and official images
description: The Samsung Galaxy A08 was spotted in the Google Play Console in August, and then got certified by Anatel in Brazil a few days later. Things have been quiet since then, but now the phone has shown up at an online retailer in the UAE, where it's seemingly already available for purchase for AED 625 ($170), down from the recommended price of AED 659 ($179). The phone sports a 6.7-inch PLS LCD screen with a 90Hz refresh rate, a 50MP main camera, a 2MP depth sensor, an 8MP front camera, and a 6,000 mAh battery with support for 25W fast charging. title: The iPhone Duo does not solve foldables' biggest problems
description: After leaking more than a communal tap, the iPhone Duo — Apple’s first foldable — is finally a reality. We are used to foldables around here, but for Apple, this is the first and only major new iPhone form factor in 19 years since the original iPhone. Needless to say, that’s a pretty big deal. But as stated before, foldables are not new to us. By now, the original Galaxy Fold units have completed seven trips around the Sun, and we have seen countless models from every other major manufacturer since then. Some have come and gone in such a blink of an eye that many people won’t even...

title: Here's how much using one phone number on two iPhones will cost you
description: In iOS 27, which is being released to everyone on Monday, Apple is introducing a new feature that will let you use one phone number on two iPhones. It's called iPhone Handoff, and during its iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Duo launch event this week, Apple announced that it will be initially available on T-Mobile in the US and Telekom in Germany. Today, T-Mobile has revealed how much this feature will cost you, and it's going to be $5 per month. Handoff lets you use one T-Mobile number across two iPhones, but it can only be active on one iPhone at a time. iPhone Handoff will...

title: Apple extends free satellite features for older iPhones
description: A footnote in the iPhone 18 Pro press release revealed that Apple is providing an additional year of free satellite features for older iPhones. This means users with compatible iPhone models dating back to 2022’s iPhone 14 series will be able to enjoy Emergency SOS via satellite, Messages via satellite, Find My via satellite, and Roadside Assistance via satellite free of charge for at least one more year. The only requirement is that the devices need to be activated before September 9, 2026. This development marks the third time that Cupertino is extending free satellite access for the...

title: Samsung’s Galaxy Buds On leak again
description: Samsung is working on a pair of open-ear clip-on wireless earbuds which are expected to launch as the Galaxy Buds On, and we now have our first official-looking renders complete with additional details thanks to a new report from SammyGuru. Samsung Galaxy Buds On (images: SammyGuru) Just as the previous renders show, Galaxy Buds On feature a two-part design with one side featuring the speaker and the other sitting behind the ear. The two sides are connected with a silicone loop, and we can also spot pogo-pin connectors, which will charge the buds when they are placed inside their...

title: Honor Watch 6 Pro's launch date and design revealed
description: Honor's Watch 6 series includes the Watch 6, Watch 6 Plus, and Watch 6 Plus Motorcycle Edition. Honor has announced that the Watch 6 Pro will join them on September 28. Honor posted a teaser on Weibo that also revealed the Watch 6 Pro's design. It shows two versions - one with a sporty look and another with a formal design. The smartwatch also has a couple of physical buttons on its right side for different actions. In addition to revealing the design, the teaser confirmed that the Watch 6 Pro will come with cardiac arrest monitoring and blood pressure monitoring. The Honor Watch...

title: Poco X8 Power with a 10,000mAh battery goes on sale in India
description: The Poco X8 was unveiled globally earlier this month, followed by its India launch alongside the X8 Power last week. The Poco X8 Power comes with a massive 10,000mAh battery and is now available for purchase in the country. It’s priced at INR 35,999 ($375) for the 8GB/128GB variant, whereas the 8GB/256GB model carries a price tag of INR 38,999 ($410). The X8 Power is being offered in Black and Yellow colorways. Aside from the large 10,000mAh battery, the Poco X8 Power comes with a 6.83-inch OLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate, up to 3,200 nits peak brightness, and a 1.5K...

title: Honor Magic9 series said to include a Super Edition with an 11,000mAh battery
description: Honor recently revealed the design of its upcoming Magic9 series but did not share any specs. A recent leak suggested that Honor would launch two models, but a new one now claims that the lineup will include the base Magic9, Magic9 Pro Max, and a Magic9 Super Edition. According to a tipster on Weibo, the entire Honor Magic9 series will use the same rear camera design showcased in recent official renders. The tipster claims that the Magic9 Super Edition will feature a 6.8-inch display with a 165Hz refresh rate. It is said to pack a 200MP primary rear camera alongside 12MP and 50MP...

title: Samsung Galaxy SmartTag3's leaked images reveal design and colors
description: Samsung launched the OG Galaxy SmartTag in 2021 and followed it with the SmartTag2 in 2023. We know Samsung is preparing to launch the third-gen SmartTag soon. Its illustrations that leaked in July revealed the tracker would come in a squircle-like shape. Now we are looking at leaked images of the Galaxy SmartTag3, giving us our first look at it. The images show the Samsung Galaxy SmartTag3 in two colors and reveal the tracker won't have a hole for a lanyard or keyring, so you'll have to shell out extra money for a separate case with an attachment loop if you want to attach the SmartTag3...

title: Here's your first look at the upcoming iQOO 16
description: After teasing the iQOO 16’s redesigned rear camera module earlier this week, the company has now offered a closer look at the phone’s overall rear design. The handset will debut later this month alongside the iQOO Pad Ultra. The iQOO 16’s square-shaped rear camera module features a raised lip surrounding the triple-camera setup, which is arranged in a unique layout. The LED flash is positioned in the top-right corner, outside the module, while the “100x Tele” text is printed inside the camera island. The raised lip appears to offer some added protection to the camera lenses, which...

title: Oppo K14 Lite is coming, launch date and design revealed
description: Oppo's K14 series currently includes two smartphones - the K14 and the K14x. Next week, these will be joined by a new member, as Oppo today announced it will unveil the K14 Lite in India on September 16 at 12 PM local time. Oppo says the K14 Lite is "designed for users who seek reliable everyday performance and a smartphone that keeps up with their daily routines." While Oppo didn't detail the K14 Lite's spec sheet, it confirmed the smartphone will pack a 7,000 mAh battery. Moreover, the images Oppo shared revealed the K14 Lite's design and color options. title: vivo X Fold6's global launch is nearing
description: vivo launched its latest foldable smartphone, the X Fold6, in China back in June. We've been patiently waiting for it to go global ever since, and while that still hasn’t happened yet, it seems like it's just around the corner now. That's because someone in possession of a global X Fold6 prototype has decided to run Geekbench on it earlier today. The global X Fold6 has the model number V2559. title: Samsung Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26 Ultra now available in India as part of Certified Re-Newed program
description: Samsung has announced that the Galaxy S26 and Galaxy S26 Ultra are now available in India through its Certified Re-Newed (CRN) program. Samsung claims that every CRN device is "inspected, cleaned, refurbished and tested through a Samsung-certified renewal process to meet Samsung’s standards for quality, performance and reliability." Each CRN device is reset to remove personal data and updated with the latest software before being sold to customers. It also packs a Samsung-certified battery, and where required, parts are replaced with genuine Samsung parts. The CRN Galaxy S26 and...

title: Xiaomi starts beta test recruitment for HyperOS 4
description: Xiaomi is now starting to recruit eager beta testers for its upcoming HyperOS 4 release for Global and EEA markets. If you want to give it a try, as always do keep in mind that beta software can have bugs and issues and is not recommended for your daily driver. If you want to go through with it even so, then you need to have a Xiaomi 17 Ultra, Leica Leitzphone by Xiaomi, or Xiaomi 17. Then, head on over to the Xiaomi Community app, tap Me, then Beta testing, and then Recruiting test. There will be a questionnaire for you to fill out. title: Qualcomm outlines the improvements in the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro's new NPU
description: Qualcomm is introducing its Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 SoC as well as the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro at its annual Snapdragon Summit on September 22. Ahead of that event, today the company is teasing the improvements it's made to one of the chips' Hexagon NPU (presumably we're talking about the Hexagon NPU of the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro).
